DESC: Overhead lines double circuit single tower, twin conductor per phase. Rating calculated for summer day, 1m/s wind speed, and air temperature of 35oC.
NT:
1. Plant amount includes: Strain + Structural tower associated costs (steel tower with single earth peak, structural foundation steel, foundation leg steel, climbing barrier, fittings, insulators) and insulator and conductor. 85% suspension, 15% strain and 400m span. Sag and OPGW has been appropriately assigned
2. Civil and structural works includes: Tower concrete footing, soil tests, installation of tower and foundations
3. Electrical works includes: installation of conductor (setup, draw wires,stringing, clamping off), installation of OHEW/OPGW (draw wire, stringing, clamping off)
4. Secondary system and testing and commissioning is accounted in the terminating end in the substation switchbay cost

DESC: Lump sum allowance for the entire project. This building block estimate is a network element by itself and accounts for all other constituiting network elements. SPS estimate excludes non-network or BESS solutions
NT: SPS are a subset of SIPS and are network solutions and will also be needed to the extent required to control non-network solutions. This building block cost estimate is applicable for the entire project (consisting of multiple network elements) and should be included by itself if it is required. SPS is over and above the traditional control, protection and comms system installed and embedded as part of standard building blocks. SPS may leverage existing/estimated assets such as OPGW, CT and other secondary system items which have already been accounted for in other network element building blocks. The objective of the SPS is to keep various parts of NEM operating securely following the non-credible loss of interconnectors and large generators and preventing cascading power outages. Use the 'station' category project attributes, known and unknown risk factors to adjust this estimated cost to suit your specific project
